title: SwiGLU MLP
hint: Three nn.Linear layers: gate_proj(d, d_ff), up_proj(d, d_ff), down_proj(d_ff, d). forward(x) = down_proj(silu(gate_proj(x)) * up_proj(x)). SiLU(x) = x * sigmoid(x).

description.text: Implement a SwiGLU feed-forward block: out = down_proj( SiLU(gate_proj(x)) * up_proj(x) ), where SiLU(x) = x * sigmoid(x). This is the FFN style used in LLaMA and similar models.

examples.output: Same shape as x after down_proj.
examples.explanation: Intermediate is (batch, seq, d_ff) after gate/up and element-wise product.

constraints: Use nn.Linear for gate_proj, up_proj, down_proj.
Do not replace the block with a single Linear.
